metadata.description: AI-native SDLC loop for Claude Code

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Runs a feature through intent, spec, RFC, plan, build, test, ship, ADR and maintain. Each stage ends by committing one artifact under docs/sdlc/<slug>/, and that commit starts the next stage.

plugins.name: sdlc-stack
plugins.description: Installs sdlc with every plugin its stages call. Its manifest is the list of those plugins and the versions the loop needs.
